native.captureMethod: Actual production JUCE editor snapshots with direct readback of each visible OpenGL surface's presented front buffer on its GL thread, vertically oriented and composited at its real clipped editor bounds. Separate GPU PNG files retain native physical resolution. Gallery cards are illustrative previews.
native.sourceFixture: Original procedural stereo music, twelve seconds of live editor warmup, then frozen measured PCM and meter history for all look comparisons.
